_why: Guard invariant 6b covers maps/ as of Task 137. The served set is DERIVED from what the pages actually fetch, so a file becomes legitimate the moment code asks for it — there is no list to maintain. This records the remainder: review sheets that NOTHING PARSES. Task 138 moved every maps/ file that a build stage actually reads (16 structure.json, 3 .retired.json, and the 3 sheets build_reception_layers.py greps) out to 05_scripts/configs/. What is left is here because its job is to be opened and read by a person, which the Task 138 ruling says to leave alone — not because it is excused by a pattern. A new stray still fails loudly.
_open_question: These are internal working documents — the design side's deliberations, candidate bindings, rights holds — and being tracked they are served at public URLs. Leaving them in place was ruled; PUBLISHING them was never separately considered. Raised in STATUS, not decided here.
